name: Greninja
description: Greninja, the Ninja Pokémon, and the evolved form of Frogadier. A Water and Dark type.
pokedex_entries: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.
It appears and vanishes with a ninja's grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.
